job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Gen AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Python, AWS Cloud, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). The ideal candidate should have expertise in building AI-powered cloud solutions and integrating APIs using Kong API Gateway.

Key Skills:

Strong experience in Generative AI, Python, Terraform (IaC), and Kong API Gateway.
Hands-on experience with AWS services including Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EC2, S3, EKS, Control Tower, AFT, CodePipeline, CloudFormation, and Secrets Manager.
Experience with Git, JIRA, Confluence, and ServiceNow.
Exposure to Microsoft Azure services is a plus.
Strong problem-solving, cloud architecture, and automation skills.
